info.title: SpashtAI workspace foundation
info.description: Local contract. Organization product requests carry the identity JWT in Authorization and the workspace JWT in x-spasht-workspace; both must name the same person, and membership, workspace state and placement are rechecked on every request. Control-plane paths (/api/workspaces, /api/auth, /api/invitations) ignore that header; /api/admin and /internal reject it with 403 WORKSPACE_CONTEXT_REJECTED. Product readiness is product code (WORKSPACE_FEATURE_READINESS); a product that is not ready returns 403 WORKSPACE_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE in an organization whatever its settings. Coach and Prepare are Personal-only. Workspace admin report and AI Analytics paths use the workspace JWT as the Bearer and are Owner/Admin only.

delete.summary: Delete tenant membership, optionally erasing tenant history
delete.description: Requires explicit history retain/delete choice. Admins may delete learners; Owners may delete administrators. Self deletion and removal of the last active Owner are refused. Workspace lock serializes membership changes, invitation acceptance and deletion. Old workspace tokens and pending invitation links cannot restore access. Retain keeps organization history; delete erases only this user’s data in this organization, with durable session/media cleanup. Other tenants, Personal history, identity, audit and consent records remain unchanged. The email stays tenant-only.

post.summary: Invite up to 20 workspace learners with separate private emails
post.description: Requires a current Owner/Admin. Maximum recipients is the tenant-configured batchSize (1–500, default 20). Oversized batches are rejected before any sends. Each recipient reserves the tenant’s persistent shared hourly allowance under the workspace row lock. hourlyLimit:null disables that cap. Per-recipient failures are returned; successful recipients are not rolled back.
